top.line: Every property of a safe agent desktop exists, separately
top.para: We want each agent to have a watchable, isolated, secret-free, disposable desktop billed by the minute. In October 2026 each property can be bought somewhere, but no product offers all nine. macOS cannot be leased for under a day, the strongest controls are new or in beta, and prompt injection is unsolved.

s0.line: A locked-down agent desktop needs nine distinct properties
s0.para: Read through the Agent Behaviour Policy, the desktop is the agent's grant and the task its mandate. The nine properties are isolation, an egress allowlist, secrets kept outside, its own identity, live view and takeover, a record, a clean reset, billing that follows the work, and the right operating system.

s1.line: Linux sandboxes lead on controls; Mac hosts lag
s1.para: E2B offers Firecracker microVMs, default-deny egress and per-second billing, with injected secrets and workload identity in private beta. Daytona has firewalls, placeholder secrets and recording. Windows 365 for Agents and Amazon WorkSpaces for AI agents arrived in June 2026, while Mac hosts give a desktop but nothing else, and not by the minute.

s2.line: Mac licensing, young controls and injection make it hard
s2.para: Apple's licence requires 24-hour leases and limits them to developer services, so two hours a day costs €116.16 on Scaleway or $649.44 on AWS, against about $7.29 on Linux. Claude's computer use is split between personal desktops and API Linux sandboxes. Injection still succeeds about 1% of the time, so the box must be the barrier.

s3.line: Build from a per-task mandate, Linux first, vault outside
s3.para: Each task gets a mandate written first, and the desktop is configured from it. Linux sandboxes are the default, Windows Cloud PCs serve Windows tools, and macOS is for development only, by the day. Outputs go to an append-only sgit vault, while open questions about takeover, state and cost need measuring.

s4.line: Startup credit programmes could fund a real evaluation
s4.para: Programmes checked on 7 October 2026 include E2B's $20,000, Daytona's Startup Grid, Scaleway, AWS Activate, Microsoft, Google Cloud, Cloudflare, Modal and Anthropic, each with eligibility rules. It is unclear whether Mac hosts are covered. MacStadium's open-source programme does not qualify, and RiskMandate offers to publish results.

s5.line: Linux and Windows nearly work; macOS does not, yet
s5.para: On Linux a safe agent desktop is possible with two key controls in beta; on Windows with four-month-old products; on macOS not by the hour, and not for general work without legal advice. Every property exists somewhere, and assembling them remains the customer's work. Prices were checked on 7 October 2026.
